holdout.commitment_rule: SHA256(domain separator pilot-v2-fresh-holdout-v1 NUL + 32 private random bytes)
holdout.future_procedure: After development calibration and protocol freeze, a separate versioned tool may consume the unopened reserved seed to draw fresh independent roots. No holdout tasks, prompts, labels or answers are generated by this module; no existing development root may enter that holdout.

legacy_overlap_audit.interpretation: Exact normalized overlap and conservative structural flags only; no proof of arbitrary graph isomorphism or algebraic inequivalence. Missing historical problem data remain explicit.

limitations: Difficulty schedules describe measured task size/work, not validated model difficulty or error rates.
Two perturbations of one problem are dependent and must remain in one root in every analysis.
Graph WL fingerprints are conservative invariants, not complete isomorphism or Boolean/algebraic equivalence tests.
Historical rows without problem data cannot receive structural fingerprints; their prompt checks and missingness are explicit.
CNF/grid feasibility is not balanced model correctness. No v1 model test labels or new model responses are used.
